$description: Plenix · Android size and behavior tokens (Plenix Platforms Standard 7.1): sizes in dp, type in sp. The names are the web token names for the same role (plx-sys, plx-comp: the interaction sets) and the Plenix text roles (plx-text--<role>), so $extensions.plenix.web names the web token each value maps to; platformOnly marks a value the web has no role for. Plenix-owned values (color, type family, radius, focus) come from the theme files, never from here. Each value names its source (2.1) and level (2.2); Material Web tokens and Compose Material 3 defaults are recorded separately.

control-target-min-pointer.$description: The smallest pointer target (3.1); the web uses control-target-min with a fine pointer.

control-height-standard.$description: The default control height: the small button (6.1).

dialog-action-gap.$description: At least this between dialog actions (3.2).

button-height-medium.$description: Material medium (6.1); no web role of this size.

button-height-large.$description: Material large (6.1); no web role of this size.

input-icon.$description: Leading and trailing icons (6.2); the web uses control-icon-standard.

switch-track-after-width.$description: The handle, on (6.3); the web handle is one size.
